title: Design Studio Selections Payments Desk Table: Returned Payment Fee Basis by Amount Returned
content:
The fee basis of a returned payment fee on a Design Studio Selections file is set by the amount returned:

| Amount returned | Fee basis |
|---|---|
| 5000.00 or more | 1 percent of the amount returned, and never less than the package's returned payment fee |
| Below 500.00 | The smaller of the package's returned payment fee and 10 percent of the amount returned |
| From 500.00 up to but not including 5000.00 | The package's returned payment fee |

**Package returned payment fee**

| Package | Returned payment fee (USD) |
|---|---|
| Studio Essentials | 35.00 |
| Studio Classic | 35.00 |
| Studio Select | 35.00 |
| Studio Designer | 35.00 |
| Studio Signature | 35.00 |
| Studio Atelier | 35.00 |

**Records read.** The amount on the returned-payment entry of the design ledger.

**Worked amounts (hypothetical; package fee 35.00)**

| Amount returned | Fee basis |
|---|---|
| 8000.00 | 1 percent: 80.00 |
| 5000.00 | 1 percent: 50.00 |
| 4999.99 | 35.00 |
| 500.00 | 35.00 |
| 499.99 | 10 percent is 49.999; the smaller is 35.00 |
| 200.00 | 10 percent is 20.00; the smaller is 20.00 |
